question: What additional petal counts are attributed to the contemplative wheels in this enumeration?
premises: Different petal counts are being enumerated.
The counts include sixteen, hundred, and crore petals.
These are presented as applicable forms.
inference: The wheels may also be contemplated as sixteen-petalled, hundred-petalled, and crore-petalled.
plain_english: They are also sixteen-petalled, hundred-petalled, and even crore-petalled.
